letters.evidence: A: far-right strip (x~1330-1485, right of a vertical seam/joint at x~1265-1323) is heavily corroded; only vertical traces at target height, no letter can be counted. B/C: no corresponding legible area.

A x~1190-1257: short vertical (x~1240) standing on a long heavy horizontal base at y~190, i.e. somewhat below the baseline of the letters to its left; no clear top bar. C right strip shows a box-like letter with low base at this end of the line, which would favour ב/כ; disagreement.

A x~1165-1198: a vertical running from ~y123 to ~y207 (below baseline) with a horizontal crossbar at mid-height extending left ('+'-like). Not a clear Hebrew letter form; could be the leg of ק or a sign. X-rays unclear here.

A x~1075-1127: clear left vertical and flat base; the right side rises and curls inward at top (S-like curl). C (both strips) shows the same curl inside a flat-based letter. Space before pos 3 uncertain.
A x~1010-1057: open-topped U: left vertical, flat base, right vertical; a middle stroke not clear in A. C left strip suggests three vertical grooves on a flat base (favouring ש).

A x~874-926: top stroke, right vertical and heavy flat base; no clear heel. B right strip shows the same letter (top line, right vertical, base) just left of the oval blob. Between pos 5 and 6 is a raised oval blob (A x~950-975; dark oval in B and C) which is a defect/hole, not a letter.
A x~838-862: partial letter cut by the fragment edge; only a base stroke and a short vertical.
Blank mounting area between fragments (A x~530-830); no metal/text. Number of lost letters unknown.
Left fragment, A x~420-505: faint corroded traces at target height, not countable with confidence (perhaps 1-2 letters).
Left fragment A x~338-400: prongs rising from a flat base, heavily corroded. B left strips show nothing legible.
Left fragment A x~265-327: a top stroke and a base with right side; corroded.
A x~77-255: surface corroded; no letters discernible at target height (a raised blob at x~180-200, y~170-210 belongs to the line below / is a defect).

P16.greek_or_numerals: Possibly one non-letter sign: the cross-shaped mark at pos 3 (vertical with mid-height crossbar, extending below the baseline). Not certain it is a sign rather than a damaged letter.
P16.image_quality: A (electrotype) most useful for the right fragment; C useful to confirm the curled letter (pos 4) and the three-prong impression of pos 5; B only covers the area around the oval blob (pos 6). Left fragment is barely legible in all images.
P16.notes: Target line spans two separate fragments with a wide gap. Oval blob between pos 5 and 6 is a defect/hole, not a letter. Letter count in far-right strip and left fragment uncertain. I suspect the object is the Copper Scroll (3Q15) from the description of the material, but I do not recall readings of individual lines and report only what I see.

letters.evidence: A x~1025-1085: inverted-V / N-like form with an extra short stroke at right, typical blocky aleph shape. X-rays: not securely located.
A x~979-1034: short left vertical meeting a long diagonal rising to the upper right (V/Y shape).
A x~943-961: simple vertical of near full height; directly above it a small raised quadrilateral blob (x~950-975, y~117-136) that looks like a casting defect rather than a letter head.
A x~882-925: two long legs under a curved roof; left leg appears to touch the roof (favouring ח over ה), but the join is not sharp.
A x~805-870: short vertical at left base plus one or two long diagonals rising to upper right; another small quadrilateral blob at top right (x~852-870). Form unclear; may be ע.
A x~775-820: tall ascender reaching into the line above, horizontal to the right at x-height, then diagonal descending to lower left.
A x~737-760: full-height vertical with small head bent to the left.

A x~660-720: top stroke with thickened left head, right vertical, flat base of about the same length; no heel projecting right at the base (so כ preferred). C left strip shows a matching box-shaped letter between two verticals.
A x~623-647: vertical with a closed rounded head (like '9'), full height. Clear word space follows (x~560-620).
A x~490-557: short top-left flag, right vertical, long base projecting beyond the vertical to the right (heel). B left strip shows vertical + long base in the same relation to the following aleph.
A x~427-487: X-shaped crossing strokes with a left diagonal; B left strip shows the same X-form.
A x~397-437: ascender coming down from above, horizontal top at mid-height and diagonal descending to lower left; the body sits high in the line.
A x~377-390: vertical in the upper half of the line (short) - may be י.
A x~349-366: long vertical with a small head, starting above the letter tops and reaching the baseline or slightly below; could also be a crack.
A x~309-343: small closed oval slanting up to the right, with a separate vertical to its left at x~275-290. Whether these form one letter (ק/ט) or two is unclear.
A x~275-290: vertical (see pos 15).
A x~215-271: heavy diagonal and horizontal strokes at the edge of a damaged/broken area; left of x~215 the surface is lost.

P17.image_quality: A is by far the most useful (sharp relief). B left strip confirms the ב and א (pos 10-11); C left strip shows the ו-כ-ו group (pos 7-9) faintly. The right part of the line was not securely located in the X-rays.
P17.notes: Right of x~1100 in A is a seam and a zone with round raised rings (rivet/hole-like), no letters at the target height except a vertical trace at the extreme right edge (x~1365), probably from the adjacent column or a crack. Two small raised quadrilateral blobs above pos 3 and pos 5 appear to be defects. Word space visible between pos 9 and pos 10.

letters.evidence: A x~1207-1250: tall ascender from the line above down to the baseline with a short hook at lower right. X-rays: right end of B right strip blurred by strip edge.
A x~1143-1197: closed inverted-triangle form (top bar, left side, diagonal from top right to bottom left) with an inner stroke. Same shape type as pos 11 and 14.
A x~1042-1120: vertical with head at left, long diagonal rising to a blob-like head at upper right, flat base below; may be one letter (צ/מ) or two (ו + ב). Small gap before pos 2.
A x~1005-1037: closed rounded loop in upper part tapering to a point at lower left; a stroke from the line above touches its top left.
A x~970-990: full-height vertical with rounded head bulging to the right.
A x~935-962: vertical with a stroke leaning out to the left at mid-height. Followed (to its left) by a raised dot at x~925, y~157, probably a word divider or blemish.
A x~840-900: small head at top left, top bar, right vertical, base longer to the left than the top bar; no heel projecting right. C left strip shows a letter with base in this group.
A x~817-833: full-height vertical with small head.
A x~763-807: right leg with roof, left leg with its own small flag; a small gap between left leg and roof (could indicate ה or two letters). B right strip shows a two-legged letter here.
A x~710-757: short left arm and long right arm descending diagonally below baseline to lower left. B right strip shows diagonal strokes in the same place.
A x~657-703: closed inverted triangle; B right strip shows the same triangular form.
A x~607-643: top bar with right vertical running slightly below the baseline; B shows top bar + long vertical.
A x~567-593: small head at top left, vertical, base running left. B right strip shows only top bar + vertical (ר-like) - disagreement on the base.
A x~507-550: closed box with overhanging top bar and an inner horizontal; B (both strips) show an inverted-triangle form like pos 11.
A x~460-497: rounded closed head with long descender reaching below the baseline; B left and right strips both show head loop + long descender.

P18.greek_or_numerals: None identified. A raised dot between pos 6 and pos 7 (possible divider).
P18.image_quality: A most useful for letter shapes; B (right strip and left strip) is unusually clear for the left half of the line (pos 10-15) and confirms the triangular letters and final ף. C left strip is harder to align.
P18.notes: Adjacent columns visible: at far left of A (x~50-160) letters of the neighbouring column at/near target height (e.g. ב/ח-like and ג/ש-like forms); at far right (x~1420-1460) a triangular mark at target height and 'ו ם'-like forms below it. Not included in the transcription. Spacing: small gaps after pos 2 and possibly after pos 6 (dot).

letters.evidence: A x~1077-1132: box-shaped letter: clear left vertical, top bar and base, right side faint/indistinct. C right strip shows left vertical + top bar at this position (crossed by a crack).
A x~1031-1065: top bar with right vertical; a raised oval blob just below it (defect). C right strip: top bar + right vertical.
A x~954-996: short ascender above the line, horizontal to the right, vertical down and a base returning left (squared hook). C right strip shows a matching box-like form with raised top-left.
A x~900-946: left leg, diagonal and right arm (N/X form); C right strip shows a clear X-shaped aleph.

A x~822-870: short top stroke (y~118-128) and a base stroke (y~175-180); the space between is filled by a raised heart-shaped blob (defect). C left strip shows a box-like letter with a round blob inside at this place, so pos 5 and pos 6 may be one letter.
A x~785-797: long, slightly slanting vertical from above the letter tops to ~25px below the baseline.
A x~727-772: roof with tall right leg; left leg starts below the roof (detached) and reaches the baseline. C left strip shows a two-legged letter with roof.
A x~692-705: short hooked stroke confined to the upper half of the line. C: short vertical.
A x~640-683: vertical with head and a base running left from its foot; C left strip shows right vertical + base.
A x~597-634: thick rounded head at top left, right vertical, base extending left beyond the head; no heel. C left strip: rounded head + right vertical + base.

A x~560-579: full-height vertical with rounded head; C shows a vertical here. To its left a long straight vertical line (A x~539-552) runs through the lines above and below: a crack/fold, not a letter (C shows a full-height line at the same place).
A x~471-535: long top bar with right vertical; a short detached diamond-shaped stroke under the left end of the bar (left leg of ה, or a separate י).
A x~455-490: base stroke at the broken fragment edge; C left strip shows top and base strokes of a box-like letter at the edge.

P19.image_quality: A most useful; C (left and right strips) is fairly clear and confirms א, ל, the נ/ב group and the crack at pos 11/12. B strips show the same fragment but less clearly at target height.
P19.notes: Right of x~1140 in A: seam and a zone with two raised oval blobs, no letters at target height. Several raised blobs (defects) sit at/below the line (below pos 2, inside pos 5, below pos 8). Long straight crack between pos 11 and 12. Left end of line broken off at x~455.

letters.evidence: A x~1034-1055: full-height vertical with rounded head bulging right. B right strip and C left strip show verticals at the right end of the line.

A x~981-1028: two verticals joined at the top by a bar that projects slightly right of the right vertical; left vertical has a blob-like head with a slight break below it. Could be one two-legged letter or ו + ד/ז.

A x~903-963: short head at top left, right vertical, base extending well to the left of the head; no heel at lower right. B right strip shows head + vertical + base. Clear blank space follows (x~800-900).
A x~776-797: vertical with thick head, ending at the baseline.
A x~739-765: small head at top left and vertical descending ~20px below the baseline.
A x~647-721: ascender rising into the line above, arm to the right, diagonal descending to lower left; a short foot below the left end. B right strip shows a matching form with ascender.
A x~619-636: long slanted stroke from the letter tops to ~35px below the baseline. B right strip shows a long diagonal crossing the whole height (more like a crack) - disagreement.
A x~546-617: rounded box, base, right vertical, left side with inward curl at top. B right and left strips show the curled form clearly.
A x~461-538: left vertical with hooked top, flat base, right vertical, inner curl at top right. B strips show two ט in succession (pos 8-9).
A x~417-453: vertical with a diagonal foot running down to the left. Not covered clearly by X-rays.
A x~380-413: V-shaped pair of arms with a tail descending to the lower left; top of arms rises higher than the ט's.
A x~337-375: vertical rising well above the line (to y~57) with a diagonal returning to the lower right; possibly ל ascender, or part of a ש with pos 11.
A x~260-337: tall two-legged letter with roof at y~57-65 and legs to y~163 (taller than neighbours; may be a letter of this line rising high).
A x~250-273: vertical with foot at the edge of the broken area.

P20.image_quality: A most useful for the whole line; B right strip very clear for the two ט (pos 8-9) and the ל, and shows the ב and verticals at the right end. C covers the right part (ב, ו-group) only faintly.
P20.notes: Line appears to rise slightly toward the left (pos 11-13 sit higher). Word space between pos 3 and pos 4. Neighbouring columns at the same height: LEFT column (A x~36-160) shows ט (x~96-160, probable) and ב (x~36-83, probable), i.e. 'טב' reading right to left; RIGHT column (A x~1277-1480) shows ב/נ-like letter (x~1277-1327), a short י/ו (x~1353-1370), a box/ב-like letter with base (x~1367-1420) and edge traces. These are not included in the transcription.

letters.evidence: A x~1085-1140: left vertical, faint top and a base projecting left, at the seam/damaged zone. C right strip and B right strip show a box-like letter at the right end of the line (top bar + verticals).
A x~1047-1070: vertical with head bent left; full height.
A x~1007-1025: vertical with head; a crack runs from its top diagonally to the right.
A x~935-990: right arm (diagonal from upper right down to the stem), stem and left leg: blocky aleph. C right strip shows an X-shaped aleph in the right half of the line.
A x~865-925: diagonal strokes and a vertical; could be a second aleph or the leg of the following letter. Shape not resolved.
A x~808-850: top bar with a triangular head at left, right vertical, base; a vertical crack/line at x~848 on its right.
A x~752-790: long vertical descending below the baseline with a horizontal crossing it near the top ('+'-like), joined to pos 8 roof.
A x~690-755: roof, right leg, left leg, with a base-like foot at lower left (ת-type). C left strip shows two tall boxes in the middle of the line (pos 8 and 10).
A x~660-680: vertical under a separate top stroke (y~110); may belong with pos 8 as a left leg.
A x~570-640: large closed rectangle (top, both sides, base); C left strip shows two well-formed closed rectangles in the line (this and pos 8), B right strip shows closed rectangles as well.
A x~555-572: vertical after a small gap, just before the fragment edge. C left strip shows a vertical at the left end.

P21.greek_or_numerals: None identified; the '+'-like crossing at pos 7 could be a sign but more likely a letter with a crack.
P21.image_quality: A most useful for stroke detail; C left strip gives the clearest confirmation of the closed rectangles (ם-type letters); B right strip also shows rectangles but its alignment to the target line is uncertain (strips offset).
P21.notes: Right of x~1150 in A: seam and a ring-shaped raised mark (rivet/hole?), no letters except two faint verticals near the right edge (x~1300-1340) which probably belong to the adjacent column. Left of x~545 the surface is lost (fragment edge). Space before pos 11 small.

letters.evidence: A x~1096-1154: small head/vertical at top left, short mid-height horizontal, a small raised ring (probably defect) and a long base at y~172. Letter form unclear.
A x~1052-1092: top bar with right vertical descending ~12px below the baseline. C strips 2 and 3 show a top-bar+vertical letter at the right end of the line.
A x~1023-1045: vertical with triangular flag head.

A x~963-1019: roof, diagonal from top right running down-left inside the letter (bowl), and a left vertical descending below the baseline. C strips 2 and 3 both show a letter with a crossing diagonal at this place.
A x~897-960: roof, right leg, left leg crossing above the roof and ending in a foot turned to the left.
A x~835-900: roof with raised peak at right end, two legs both attached; left leg pokes above roof; no foot.
A x~760-823: roof, right leg, left leg crossing above roof with foot turned left at the bottom. C strip 2 shows a two-legged letter here.
A x~690-752: rounded top-left corner, top bar, right vertical, left side curving down about two-thirds of the height, base extending further left than the top. Closed/open not certain.
A x~617-686: vertical with feathered head and a base running left from its foot; a thin diagonal crack crosses the lower left. If the base belongs to pos 10, read ו.
A x~572-612: top bar, right vertical, base; its left side is a tall stroke rising above the letter tops (ascender?). B strip 2 shows top bar with verticals here.

A x~515-572: long vertical (above top to below baseline) with a ring-shaped bulge at mid-height and a short horizontal. B (both strips) shows a dark hole (defect) at this position, so the ring is probably the hole outline, not a letter stroke.
A x~480-500: vertical, mid to lower part of the line.
A x~402-470: closed box with a pointed (gabled) top and an inner horizontal stroke. B strips 1 and 2 both show a clear gable-topped closed box with base line.
A x~351-404: left vertical with two parallel diagonals rising to the upper right from its lower part. B strips show the same diagonal group.
A x~300-350: an arched stroke above a damaged area (dark raised blob and crack below the baseline).
A x~230-290: roof over two strong legs; B strip 1 shows a two-legged letter with a peaked roof at the left end.
A x~205-225: faint vertical under the left end of the roof of pos 16 (may be part of pos 16).

P22.image_quality: A (electrotype) most useful; B strips clear for the gable box and diagonal letter (pos 13-14) and show a hole at pos 11; C strips show the ק/ח/ת sequence faintly.
P22.notes: No clear word spaces seen. Right of the main column (A x~1160-1285) is a blank margin; the adjacent column to the right shows at target height a vertical (x~1295), a rounded arch letter (x~1330-1370) and a small letter (x~1385). Left of x~200 is the column margin/edge. The strips in C are three overlapping X-rays of the same area.

letters.evidence: A x~1015-1040: full-height vertical with blunt head, just left of the vertical seam. C right strip shows a vertical at the right end of the line.

A x~945-1000: dark wedge/inverted-triangle: short top at y~115-125 (x~965-1000) and a diagonal running to the lower left (x~945, y~178); no base. C right strip shows a V-shaped pair of diagonals with a blob at this place.
A x~880-935: triangular flag at top left, top bar, right vertical down to the baseline with a knob at the upper right corner (the knob may indicate ד).
A x~800-850: roof at y~125-135 with right leg to the baseline; left leg (x~805) starts clearly below the roof (y~160). C left strip shows a roof letter in this position.
A x~722-770: head at top left, top bar, right vertical down to the baseline; no left leg. C left strip: top bar + right vertical.
A x~660-710: vertical (x~705) with a curved foot leaving it at ~2/3 height and running down to the lower left. C left strip shows the same vertical-with-curved-foot clearly.
A x~600-650: head at top left, top bar, right vertical, base (x~590-650) extending slightly right; C left strip and B right strip both show a closed-cornered box with base (ב/כ).

A x~522-575: roof (y~128) with right leg (x~568) and a second leg (x~533) under it. Above its left end is the flag of pos 9, so the roof might instead be the arm of a ל. B right strip shows a top bar with verticals here.
A x~503-522: raised flag above the line (y~88-115) on a short stroke, and a vertical (x~508) in the line from y~135 to 195. Relation to pos 8 unclear.

A x~393-450: head at top left, top bar, right vertical down to the baseline; a curved line from its foot toward the right (probably a crack). B left strip: flag + top bar + right vertical. Blank/damaged zone x~450-500 before it (possible word space).
A x~363-387: drop-shaped vertical with thick head, y~118-165 (shorter than full height). B left strip shows a vertical with loop head.
A x~305-355: tall zigzag: stroke from above the line (y~40) down, arm to the right at y~95-100, then diagonal back to lower left ending at y~140. B left strip shows the identical zigzag.

P23.image_quality: A most useful; B left strip confirms the ל zigzag, ו and ר at the left end; C left strip confirms ב and the vertical-with-foot (ג). Target line in B/C strips is offset ~20-40px downward relative to A.
P23.notes: Right of x~1045 in A is a vertical seam followed by an uninscribed strip and another fragment; at the far right edge (x~1370-1410) a letter trace (ל-like) of the adjacent column is visible at target height (not included). Left of x~300 is a crack/fragment edge with small traces (x~230-290) not countable. Possible word space between pos 9 and pos 10.

letters.evidence: A x~977-990: full-height vertical (y~100-157) with a head slanting to the upper left; immediately right of it is the fragment edge/crack. C strip 2 shows a vertical at the right end of the line.
A x~947-970: heavy head with short bar to the right at the top (y~85-100) and a vertical descending from the left part of the bar to y~157. C strip 2: vertical with small top (ו/ר).

A x~898-935: arch with rounded top-left corner, roof, right vertical to ~y152; left side visible only in the upper half in A. C strip 2 shows the same rounded-roof letter with the left side continuing down (two legs), so ח preferred; closure at the base not seen.
A x~855-885: large head/short top bar (y~90-102) and a long vertical descending well below the baseline (to y~177). C strip 2 shows a long descender here.
A x~800-846: heavy top bar with thick head at left, right vertical (x~832-840) to the baseline; bar projects slightly beyond the vertical. C strips 1 and 2: top bar + right vertical.

A x~745-802: left vertical (x~745-755), short upper stroke, and a long diagonal from upper left (767,112) to lower right (802,135). C strips 1 and 2 both show a K/X-shaped letter (vertical plus crossing diagonals) here, which supports א.

A x~650-705: left arm descending (x~655-667, y~100-148) meeting a shallow stroke rising to the right (to x~700, y~139); another short stroke above at x~690-705. The dark vertical band at x~715-735 before it is a crack/fold, not a letter. C strip 1: left vertical with base/diagonal rising right.
A x~570-637: top bar (x~605-635, y~102-107), right leg (x~632) descending to y~177, left leg (x~603) with a foot turned left along the baseline (x~570-605, y~160).

A x~485-555: joint at lower left (x~514, y~134) with a vertical rising from it and two diagonals rising to the upper right (to x~555); an extra diagonal x~485-515 in the upper part. C strip 1 shows a similar joint-with-rising-arms form.
A x~466-482: vertical with a head, y~66-126 (sits high).
A x~425-445: faint diagonal traces in the upper part of the line; left of x~400 the surface is lost at the fragment edge.

P24.image_quality: A most useful for detail. C strip 2 is unusually clear for pos 1-6 and supports the aleph and the long descender; C strip 1 covers pos 5-9 faintly. B is too blurred at target height (thick metal, cracks, a large hole) to be of use.
P24.notes: A: vertical crack/fold at x~715-735 separates pos 6 and pos 7 (probably not a word space, but spacing uncertain). Right of x~1010 in A is a raised/damaged area and the adjacent column; the adjacent column (x~1240-1370) has letters at target height (not included). Line seems to rise slightly to the left.

letters.evidence: A x~985-1040: diagonal head at top left (y~150-160), right vertical (x~1025, y~160-200), base (y~195-200); a small blob inside. Sits low (y~150-200). C right strip and B right strip: no clear confirmation.
A x~940-975: short horizontal stroke with a thickened left end at y~155-165; may be a small letter or a mark/defect.

A x~870-945: ascender (x~895) from y~75 to ~130, short diagonal to the right, then a vertical (x~935, y~150-190) and a base returning left along y~190 to x~870 (squared hook). If the lower box is a separate letter, read ל + ב.

A x~805-865: roof (y~125-130) with peaked head at x~845, roof overhanging right; right leg x~848 and left leg x~810 both visible from y~148 to 195, junction with roof weak. C left strip shows a two-legged roofed letter here.
A x~718-790: roof (y~125-135) with peak at x~770, right leg (x~768) attached, left leg (x~728) attached at the left end; no foot. C left strip shows a clear two-legged roofed letter.
A x~650-700: raised head at top left (y~105-130), top bar at y~130, right vertical (x~693) down to y~195. C left strip: peaked head + bar + right vertical.
A x~615-645: drop-shaped vertical with rounded head, y~120-180. C: vertical with head.

A x~525-600: straight vertical (x~570) from well above the line (y~20, crossing the line above) down to y~175, a base running left (to x~530) at y~175, and a short arm rising to the right at y~115-130 (to x~598). The long straight upper part may be a crack (it has the same sharp straight profile as cracks elsewhere) or a ל ascender.
A x~465-520: left vertical (x~470, y~120-170) with two curved strokes rising from its lower part to the upper right (to x~515, y~115). B left strip shows a comparable form.
A x~415-460: ascender from above the line (y~65) down to y~115, arm to the right along y~120-130, then hook back down-left ending at y~150. B left strip shows a hooked letter in the same region.
A x~340-395: faint diagonal strokes; a small figure-8 raised blob at x~395-410 (defect).
A x~300-345: curved stroke at top (y~85-110) and a vertical (x~320) from y~130 to 195 with a foot turning right at the bottom; may belong partly to the line below.

A x~160-215: head at top (y~95), right vertical (x~210, y~95-145), base (y~145) running left to x~160. Separated from pos 12 by a vertical fold/crack zone (x~235-290), so a space or lost letters there cannot be excluded.

P25.image_quality: A most useful. C left strip clearly confirms the sequence of two roofed two-legged letters, ר and ו (pos 4-7). B strips are blurred at target height; B left strip only roughly supports the hooked ל (pos 10).
P25.notes: The target line rises toward the left: letters at the right end sit at y~150-200, at the left end at y~95-150. The small letters at the far right edge of A (x~1250-1400, adjacent column) were not transcribed. Vertical fold/crack between pos 12 and 13 (x~235-290).

letters.evidence: A x~982-1010: single diagonal stroke rising to the upper right (y~150 to ~118), just left of the vertical seam at x~1025. Could be a small letter or a stray mark.
A x~925-975: slanting vertical (x~960-968, y~95-140) with a heavier stroke along the baseline (x~925-975, y~140-155) running left from its foot.
A x~878-932: vertical (x~888, y~95-150) with a point at lower left and two diagonals rising from its lower part to the upper right (to x~925-932, y~100).
A x~805-870: heavy roof (y~85-95) with raised head at the left end, right leg (x~862) down to ~y160, left leg (x~822) from ~y100 to ~145; the join of the left leg with the roof is unclear.
A x~778-800: vertical with a head at top left (y~75-90), running down to ~y155.
